text: What if all glue on Earth vanished for five seconds? Bad news. Your shoes just quit.
Sneaker soles peel off mid step. Labels, stamps, stickers. All on the floor.
Your cheap shelf? That's wood chips and glue. Was. Now it's sawdust.
Every paperback explodes into loose pages. Every cardboard box unfolds. Mid delivery.
Phone screens pop off. And your windshield? It's glued in. Was glued in. Damn.
Glue is back. Exactly where it was. Which is now the floor.
Somewhere on the highway, a guy in socks is holding his windshield. Alive. And very sticky.
What should disappear next? Say it in the comments, or I pick something worse.
